Name: Pocket Constellation
Author: BritishW
Description:
Pocket Constellation is a lightweight visual SMAPI mod that gives your character a simple but memorable identity: four small colored stars orbiting around the farmer at all times.
What this mod does:
  - Adds 4 animated colored stars around the player
  - Makes the character stand out visually without changing balance
  Why use it:
  - Great if you want a small magical cosmetic effect without touching gameplay
This mod is purely visual and designed to be simple, clean, and fun.

Downloads.Description: Adds four colorful stars orbiting around the player at all times. Lightweight visual SMAPI mod with no config and no gameplay changes.
